title: Send a design preview before making the product

content_json.title: Send a design preview before making the product
content_json.what_it_means: Customers should see the look before you start making the order.
what_to_do: Ask for name, photo, colour, size, and spelling.
Send a simple preview image or mockup.
Start making only after the customer confirms.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can reply: I will send a preview first. Please check name, photo, colour, size, and spelling before I make it.
content_json.why_this_helps: This prevents mistakes and makes customers feel safe before paying.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if fewer people ask what happens if the design is wrong.

title: Use a safe six-step custom order process

content_json.title: Use a safe six-step custom order process
content_json.what_it_means: Custom orders need a clear process because small mistakes can create big problems.
what_to_do: Customer sends name, photo, design idea, and delivery date.
Final photo is sent before delivery.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can pin this process in Instagram highlights and send it as the first WhatsApp reply.
content_json.why_this_helps: Customers trust the order more when every step is clear.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if customers send complete details faster after reading the process.

title: Explain advance payment in a calm way

content_json.title: Explain advance payment in a calm way
content_json.what_it_means: Customers should understand why advance payment is needed for custom work.
what_to_do: Ask for advance only after preview and timing are confirmed.
Explain that custom material and making time are reserved.
Send a simple payment confirmation message.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: Once you confirm the preview, we take advance so we can reserve material and start your custom order.
content_json.why_this_helps: Clear payment rules reduce doubt and awkward price conversations.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if fewer customers stop replying when advance payment is mentioned.

title: Send a final photo before delivery

content_json.title: Send a final photo before delivery
content_json.what_it_means: Customers feel safer when they see the finished product before it reaches them.
what_to_do: Send it before delivery or pickup.
Ask the customer to confirm the details once more.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can send: Your order is ready. Please check the final photo before delivery in {{deliveryArea}}.
content_json.why_this_helps: It reduces delivery-time worry and shows that the shop checks details.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if customers reply faster and share happier feedback after delivery.

title: Show the material before people ask

content_json.title: Show the material before people ask
content_json.what_it_means: People want to know if the product will look and feel good in real life.
what_to_do: Record close-up videos of the material.
Show thickness, finish, size, and packaging.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can post a Reel showing the material of a custom gift before the design is added.
content_json.why_this_helps: Material clarity reduces quality doubt and makes price easier to accept.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if people ask fewer basic quality questions in messages.
